name: Tachibana Takeaki
source: Takeaki is [url=https://vndb.org/c22211]Yuuji[/url]'s uncle and [url=https://vndb.org/c189]Saki[/url]'s father. He is a rather loud and very strong man who once ran an inn but now fishes for a living.
translation: 武明是[url=https://vndb.org/c22211]雄二[/url]的叔叔，也是[url=https://vndb.org/c189]咲[/url]的父亲。他曾经营旅馆，如今以捕鱼为生，是个嗓门很大、力气也很强的男人。
